title: Lakshya Sen Reaches Hylo Open Semifinals After Dominant Win
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen has advanced to the semifinals of the Hylo Open, showcasing strong form.
summary: Lakshya Sen secured his spot in the Hylo Open semifinals with a decisive victory over Kalle Koljonen, taking control in the third game.

title: Sindhu to Face Anmol in All-Indian Hylo Open Semifinal
indian_angle: PV Sindhu's win sets up an exciting all-Indian semifinal clash against teenager Anmol, guaranteeing an Indian finalist at the Hylo Open.
summary: Top-ranked Indian PV Sindhu dominated her quarterfinal match against Schulz and will now compete against fellow Indian teenager Anmol in the Hylo Open semifinals.

title: India Men's Hockey Team Beats Japan in Asian Champions Trophy
indian_angle: The Indian men's hockey team maintained its winning streak in the Asian Champions Trophy by defeating Japan with a late surge of goals.
summary: India's men's hockey team faced a tough challenge from Japan but scored three goals in the final quarter to secure a 4-1 victory and continue their winning run in the Asian Champions Trophy.

title: Manisha Wins Historic Gold at Wrestling World Championships
indian_angle: Manisha has made history by becoming the first Indian woman to win a gold medal at the Wrestling World Championships.
summary: Manisha secured a historic gold medal at the Wrestling World Championships, becoming the first Indian woman to achieve this feat, with other Indian medallists also noted.

title: Indian Kabaddi Teams Reach Commonwealth Championship Finals
indian_angle: Both the Indian men's and women's kabaddi teams have successfully advanced to the finals of the Commonwealth Kabaddi Championships held in Ahmedabad.
summary: The Indian men's and women's teams have both qualified for the finals of the Commonwealth Kabaddi Championships 2026, hosted in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
